whyUs.title: Why choose Babylon
whyUs.lead: We handle the whole process for you — translation, notarization, apostille and legalization — so you don't need to visit several different offices. We put particular emphasis on translation into Polish: given how close Lutsk is to the Polish border, it's one of the most requested directions among our clients.

items.question: How much does document translation or an apostille cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the language, the size of the document and how urgently you need it. Call us or message us — we'll give you an exact price right away.

items.question: How long does an apostille take in Lutsk?
items.answer: The apostille timeline depends on the authority that issued the document and how urgent the order is. Please check current timeframes by phone or messenger.

items.question: Do you translate documents into Polish?
items.answer: Yes — translation into Polish is one of our most popular services, given how close Lutsk is to the Polish border. We provide both standard and notarized translation.
